# Consolidate

1. Record shipped, in-progress, blocked, and next state.
2. Link evidence and exact resume point.
3. Separate project convention, cross-project capability, and temporary scratch.
4. Avoid secrets, personal data, and duplicated source content.

## Output

Produce an updated handoff and only the durable memory warranted by evidence.

## Would Revise If

Revise by 2026-10-21 if a fresh session cannot resume from the handoff or if
consolidation creates duplicate sources of truth.
